name: pictocity
description: Photoshop-style ad editor with a JSON layer document, a headless renderer and an MCP server so an agent and a human can edit the same file.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pictocity/core && npm run build -w @pictocity/server && npm run build -w @pictocity/mcp && npm run build -w @pictocity/editor
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @pictocity/server & npm run dev -w @pictocity/editor
